purpose: List two coexisting characteristics with emphasis on both.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Aも + predicate ば-form + Bも + predicate
She can both sing and play the piano.
This town has both sea and mountains.
The participants include both students and company employees.
formation: Aも + predicate ば-form + Bも + predicate
restrictions: The ば is additive here, not a condition.
mistake: Do not read the second characteristic as the result of the first.
